notes: No game type is discernible: this is a physics-vehicle test area, a default-size grey baseplate with a scooter-sized floating part to spawn into, so stage A lands on None rather than on an invented genre. I checked Simulation's Vehicle Sim before falling back here and rejected it because there is no persistent world, no hauling roads and no operating loop yet, only a placeholder chassis on a plate. All five axes sit at their defaults, which routes P0: one exterior single-surface plate, nothing stacked, nothing that has to be structurally valid. Decided without a user: kept spawn-area for the stated spawn part and boundary-edge for the plate's edge as the map limit, and emitted no preset because an untextured grey placeholder contradicts the dressing every no-genre preset carries.
